means: Past the face to a single feature filling the frame - an eye, a mouth, a hand, one object.
does: Crops to one thing. The shot_size sweep's extreme_close panel is a single eye, iris edge to edge; the shot_purpose detail panel is the same. Because nothing else is in frame, everything else in your prompt stops rendering - costume, location, other characters, weather all silently drop out. That is the trap: an extreme close-up discards most of what you wrote, so tag the FEATURE, not the character.
reach_for_it: an insert or a detail beat - the pendant blazing, the number on the shirt, the eye going wide. One per scene; two in a row and the audience loses the room.
used_in: the detail clause of shot.purpose; the macro option of shot.lens.look ("macro lens, extreme close-up, macro photography"); the pendant inserts 080_pendant and 100_dropped in films/chrono.json
